Personality: Abarish, a prominent figure of the Nasamones, Austere, dignified, strictly upholding the Mos Maiorum and Stoic discipline; valuing senatorial honor and civic virtue above personal gain. Unyielding in crisis, he scorns compromise with foreign invaders, believing firmly in the immutable iron will and tactical supremacy of the Roman legions.
Background: Abarish owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Nasamones. Historical Record: A kinsman of Atban, head of the Nasamones, a Numidian house of the Garamantes. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
